 is described at the top of forecast.js; the cities are FC_CITIES there.
 data-icons: the D*, N* and W* condition icons, named as on the current
 conditions page. wx-icons/ is the SVG set made by tools/build_wx_icons.py;

 Precipitation amounts are liquid equivalent. Snow amounts use an adaptive snow-to-liquid ratio. 
 This page checks for a new forecast every 60 minutes while it’s open.
